summary_en: This Phase II study tests tucatinib and trastuzumab, given with standard chemotherapy, in people with HER2-positive locally advanced rectal adenocarcinoma. Tucatinib is taken by mouth at 300 mg twice a day, and trastuzumab is given every three weeks, for an initial 6-week lead-in, then standard induction chemotherapy continues with both drugs for five more cycles (15 extra weeks). The record does not state the main outcome measure; the study is Phase II.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase II evalúa tucatinib y trastuzumab, administrados junto con quimioterapia estándar, en personas con adenocarcinoma rectal localmente avanzado HER2 positivo. El tucatinib se toma por vía oral a 300 mg dos veces al día, y el trastuzumab se administra cada tres semanas, durante un periodo inicial de 6 semanas; después, la quimioterapia de inducción estándar continúa con ambos medicamentos por cinco ciclos adicionales (15 semanas). El registro no indica la medida principal de resultado; el estudio es de fase II.
who_for: Be 18 years of age or older
Rectal adenocarcinoma confirmed as HER2-positive by lab testing
Locally advanced disease within 15 cm of the anal verge, with no distant spread
Tumor tests RAS wild-type and has intact mismatch repair or microsatellite stability
not_for: Prior pelvic radiation, chemotherapy, or surgery for rectal cancer
HIV, active hepatitis B or C, or chronic liver disease
